purpose: Outcome-blind endpoint/identity/schema/retention feasibility, never an evaluation cohort or trading rule.

future_selection.rule: Use earliest pilot capture by actual capture_started_at, then earliest kickoff/numeric game ID among rows with both selected books.

older_selection.rule: Among original captured pregame quotes with kickoff<=2026-09-02T00:00Z, sort actual recorded receipt, then kickoff, numeric game ID and book; select first game.

selected.provider_id_resolution: Required: exact home/away identity and kickoff from historical/events on 2026-08-29 UTC; do not reuse another provider ID.
selected.receipt_evidence: local_metadata_sha256_and_filesystem_dates; raw archive not committed to Git; not independently timestamp-attested

calls.purpose: Fresh explicit Over/Under full-state schema and remaining-quota receipt for selected future event.
Future DraftKings movement shape on the already-captured fixed line.
Future FanDuel movement shape on the already-captured fixed line.
Resolve selected older game to this provider using identity fields only.
Validate explicit closing-total Over/Under fields; select one smallest valid reported total per book for retention probe only.
Older DraftKings retention/schema check only; skip if ID or unambiguous line unavailable.
Older FanDuel retention/schema check only; skip if ID or unambiguous line unavailable.

eighth_call_reserve: Only a source-documented continuation needed to complete the same exact-day historical event discovery, if explicitly indicated by the response. Otherwise unused. No arbitrary retries or alternative game/date/line queries.
quota_guard: Before call1 use current local allowance to ensure capacity; after call1 require valid remaining metadata >=7 reserved possible calls+20 reserve. Recheck remaining headers after every call and stop before crossing reserve. Stop on401/403/429; no subscriptions, book changes or quota expansion.
future_line_rule: Keep each book line from first pilot capture, even if fresh current line differs.
older_line_rule: From call5 each book selects the smallest positive finite half-point full-game Totals line having unambiguous explicit paired over/under decimal prices>1. Ignore outcomes. Selection is only endpoint/retention preflight; closing-conditioned lines cannot define a backtest cohort.
response_evidence: Original unparsed bodies and sanitized request/HTTP receipts outside frozen pilot, plus schemas/counts and identity/side/time/line observations. No scores, weather values, winner, ROI, EV or signal tables.
limits: The older original quote receipt is supported by local metadata and raw hashes, not independent timestamp attestation.
Provider-reported historical ticks retrieved now are different evidence from original pregame receipts.
No generic home/away to Over/Under mapping is assumed; symmetric prices cannot disambiguate sides.
No timestamp unit, suspension history, uninterrupted availability, pregame role, complete line-history or retention guarantee is inferred from one successful response.
Do not substitute a different event/book/line to repair missingness or change the frozen pilot/live policies.
